Our Story

A little music while you scroll 🎵

“Filling the giant canvas of life with laughter, music, nature, and play with our loved ones.”

We're silicon valley tech bruhs who like hiking, avocados, trying to protein max while being most satisfied with sambhar, thayir saadam, lots of ice cream and good cinema. 😎

Shashank bumped into my profile online while I was visiting SF (what are the odds?!), despite us having mutual friends, living in the same city for over 7 years and being Bangaloreans. He then tried to 'friend me' on fb :p, and luckily we've not been able to stop talking since.

What to Expect

A little guide to the rituals of our South Indian wedding, so you can follow along with us.

Vratham

Prayers that prepare the groom to step from bachelorhood into married life, seeking the blessings of our ancestors.

Kasiyatra

The groom playfully sets off for Kasi to live as an ascetic - until the bride's family lovingly persuades him to choose marriage and family life instead.

The 'Oonjal' Ceremony

The couple sit together on a decorated swing while friends and family sing. Its gentle rise and fall stands for life's ups and downs, faced side by side.

Mangalya Dharanam

The most precious moment: seated on her father's lap, the groom ties the mangalya sutra around the bride's neck, with prayers for a long and happy life together.

Sapthapadhi

The couple take seven steps together, each one a vow - a happy home, strength, prosperity, harmony, family, lifelong care, and true companionship.

Pani Grahanam

The groom takes the bride's right hand and recites the marriage vows in four mantras, calling on Agni, Saraswathi and Vayu for blessing and a meeting of minds.

Nalangu

The wedding evening is for play - songs, turmeric paste, mirrors, and papads broken over each other's heads as both families join the fun.

Vadhu Gruhapravesham
Monday · Nov 2, 2026

The bride's ceremonial first step into her new home. Welcomed with aarti at the door, she gently tips a pot of rice across the threshold with her right foot, inviting prosperity in.
